tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Window background, the title bar, the gaps between tiles; also the field of the Map graph and of quiet boxes inside a card.

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: Deep cream: the Sessions tile, the explorer's rail, segmented-control tracks, section buttons.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards: the Shortcuts card, the Map panel and its rail, dialogs, menus, popovers, the editor.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Text and structure on cream; the fill of the terminal tile, the Extensions tile, the tab on show and claimed Tickets.

tokens.name: slate-deep
tokens.usage: Wells inside a slate tile: the terminal's status bar, the Extensions menu's segmented track.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy and titles on ground, tile and card (11:1 or more).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: Session subtitles, metadata, timestamps (5.4:1 on ground).

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled labels, placeholders, hidden and greyed Sessions only; never text that must be read.

tokens.name: on-slate
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a slate fill.

tokens.name: on-slate-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on a slate fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Lime. Actions only: primary buttons, the '+' buttons, the working dot, Frontier Tickets, the logo's marker stroke. Never as text on cream.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Soft lime: the 'Typed, not sent' banner, a Session waiting for the user, picked rows of a multi-selection.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Dark lime for text and glyphs on cream: links on hover, a waiting Session's glyph and word, YAML keys in the editor.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a lime fill.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card edges, dividers inside a card.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Outlines of secondary buttons, inputs and quiet tabs.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: a blocked Ticket's dashed outline, toggles off, graph edges (3:1 or more).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px keyboard focus ring on cream; lime (accent) inside a slate tile.

tokens.name: dormant
tokens.usage: The hollow ring of a tab not started yet or ended.

tokens.name: done
tokens.usage: A finished turn's check mark and word, a closed Ticket's check mark. Always with a glyph or word.

tokens.name: waiting
tokens.usage: A Session waiting for the user: its hand glyph and word, on soft lime. Always with the glyph and word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions (Delete) and errors. Always with a glyph or word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind error banners and the danger button's hover.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text selection in panels and in the editor.

tokens.name: terminal
tokens.usage: The terminal tile and the xterm.js theme's background.

tokens.name: terminal-text
tokens.usage: The xterm.js theme's foreground.

tokens.name: terminal-selection
tokens.usage: Text selection in the terminal.

tokens.name: ansi-black
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 0.

tokens.name: ansi-red
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 1 (removed lines in diffs, errors).

tokens.name: ansi-green
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 2 (added lines in diffs).

tokens.name: ansi-yellow
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 3.

tokens.name: ansi-blue
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 4.

tokens.name: ansi-magenta
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 5.

tokens.name: ansi-cyan
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 6.

tokens.name: ansi-white
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 7.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-black
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 8 (dim text, Claude Code's hints).

tokens.name: ansi-bright-red
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 9.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-green
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 10.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-yellow
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 11.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-blue
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 12.

styles.name: display-title

styles.name: display-tile

styles.name: display-logo

styles.name: text-eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase labels inside a tile: Project names, DESTINATION, QUESTION.

styles.name: mono-code
styles.usage: Commands, paths and ids shown in panels and dialogs.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a glyph and its label; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Row padding, gap between buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: The gap between tiles, and around them in the window.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding inside a tile, gap between its sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; gap between graph ranks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between Tickets in one graph rank.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Glyph wells, inputs in dense rows, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Rows, inputs, Ticket nodes, notices inside a tile.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, boxes inside a tile.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Every tile: the side panels, the terminal, the rails.

tokens.name: radius-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, tabs, status pills, dots.

tokens.name: size-titlebar
tokens.usage: Height of the window title bar with the logo and the tabs.

tokens.name: size-tab
tokens.usage: Height of a tab and of the title bar's round buttons.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Minimum height of an explorer row and an Extensions row.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Height of buttons and inputs inside a tile.

tokens.name: size-explorer
tokens.usage: Default explorer width (resizable 220 to 480).

tokens.name: size-map
tokens.usage: Default Map panel width (resizable 340 to 800).

tokens.name: size-rail
tokens.usage: Width of a collapsed side panel's rail.

tokens.name: size-ticket
tokens.usage: Width of a Ticket node in the graph.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers above the tiles.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-node-lift
tokens.usage: A hovered workable Ticket node.
